final: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) AS average_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) AS average_HCT FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS test WHERE test.ID = p.ID AND test."U-PRO" = '-' AND test.RA = '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY average_HCT IS NULL, average_HCT DESC LIMIT 10
